items.quote: - "A wheel built with uv build --offline --wheel from a temp copy of databasise/ lists databasise/tools/check_import_boundary.py, databasise/evidence/eval-bundles/bundle@v1/bundle.json, databasise/tests/fixtures/corpus/MANIFEST.json and databasise/tests/fixtures/eval-corpus/MANIFEST.json in its RECORD (TOOL-01, D-01)"

- "python -m databasise.parity.import_index parses argv with argparse before taking the store lock: --help exits 0 and an unknown flag such as --verfiy exits 2, and neither calls import_v1_index or verify_import or touches the store root (TOOL-02, D-05)"

- "verify_import reports a graph-topology violation, never 'verified', when the v1 graph exists and the v2 graph namespace is absent; a missing v2 store is a 'refused' result with assertion 'precondition', added to the Violation.assertion Literal (TOOL-03, D-06)"

- "For run_arm, storage_audit, run_comparison, run_cross_modality, aa_run and remint, each named failure the CLI can meet (MissingParityEnvKeyError, UnparseableProviderRoutingError, a SeamRefusalError subclass, FileNotFoundError, BundleDriftError, CorpusDriftError, MissingTargetFamilyError, aa_run's named ValueError subclasses, an openai network error) injected from the builder or loader returns 1 with exactly one stderr line naming the class and no traceback (TOOL-04, D-03)"

- "build_hipporag_index --spend on an empty tmp store root builds with stub clients, and a build whose fake chunk embedder writes nothing raises the named post-build error ChunkCountMismatchError (TOOL-05)"
- "The index-identity preflight verifies the same v1_working_dir the v1 arm runs against (verify_fn receives v1_working_dir) (TOOL-06)"

- "The v1 driver makes exactly one await rag.aquery_llm(query, param) call per job and never calls aquery or aquery_data, so keyword extraction runs once and the returned ids and answer come from the same retrieval (TOOL-07, D-08, G-27)"

- "storage_audit exits 3 and prints 'partial' or 'cycle' when run_audit returns a partial run or a cyclic wiring; nodes whose trace status is not-scheduled are reported 'unreached', never 'no-touch', and the summary adds unreached=N after the three pinned counts (TOOL-08, D-03, D-09)"

- "Before any client is built or any provider called, run_cross_modality checks with cli.check_named_arm that the LightRAG capability selector resolves to arm naive and the HippoRAG one to arm hipporag, each with its own wiring_id, and refuses by name otherwise; the §18.4 capability selectors stay (TOOL-09, D-10, M-08)"

- "databasise.run_wiring canonicalises the wiring document before parse_wiring and before any node runs, so a wiring with 2**70 at its top level raises CanonicalisationError with zero nodes dispatched (TOOL-10, D-11)"
